description: 1. Agent reads project-brief.md and the SKILL.md to understand the full workflow. 2. Agent detects the output/ directory exists in the workspace and therefore MUST place output in output/UrbanFarm-2025/03 - Deep Research/ (not in ./UrbanFarm-2025/ or ./research/). 3. Agent creates the directory output/UrbanFarm-2025/03 - Deep Research/. 4. Agent launches three parallel research agents (one per topic: vertical farming economics, hydroponics vs soil-based, regulatory landscape), each performing 4-6 rounds of retrieval with declared non-overlapping keyword directions. 5. Agent generates three individual research documents named with YYMMDD prefix (e.g., 250615 Economics of Vertical Farming.md), each containing: **Generated** metadata field, ## Core Conclusions section, Roman numeral main sections (## I., ## II., ## III.), ## III. Application Recommendations with (1)/(2) subsections, inline citation links [text](url) at the point of reference (NOT a trailing References section). 6. Agent generates 000.Research-Overview.md containing: **Generated** date field, research method/total rounds metadata, a | No. | Research Topic | File Size | Core Value | table with URL-encoded links (./YYMMDD%20Topic-Name.md), ## Core Findings section, and ## Comprehensive Recommendations with a markdown action checklist (- [ ] items). 7. Agent must NOT create sub-subdirectories inside 03 - Deep Research/, NOT create a separate executive summary file, and NOT list references separately at document end.
